title: HandState
description: One sampled snapshot of a hand.

all_enabled.description: Whether the provider believes every axis is enabled.

enabled.description: Per-axis enabled flags, as the hand reports them.

error_code.description:
The most recent device error record, `0` for none. What the number
is depends on the model, so a consumer compares it with `0` and with
its own previous value, and reads `faults` for its meaning; each hand
provider documents its own record.

faults.description: Human descriptions of every fault currently reported.

features.description:
Capability tokens, repeated here so a consumer that only polls state
does not have to fetch capabilities separately.

grip_force.description: The grip-force report of the end_effector.shm/1 grip-force convention (spec section 9.2): how the hand takes `force_percent` and the force in effect. Optional: a hand provider built before the convention publishes none.

applied_value.description: The force setting in effect, in `unit`, after rounding; null when not known.

approx_newtons.description: The approximate grip force in newtons of the value in effect, only where the vendor documentation gives a basis; otherwise null.

approx_newtons_range.description: The approximate newtons at `range.min` and `range.max`, by the same rule as `approx_newtons`.

mode.description: `adjustable`: `force_percent` maps onto an adjustable force. `fixed`: the hand has no adjustable grip force and applied its fixed force. `not_taken` is written only by the daemon.

range.description: The native values `force_percent` 0 and 100 map to, in `unit`; null unless `mode` is `adjustable`.

requested_percent.description: The `force_percent` of the newest `set`; null when it named none or no `set` has arrived.

unit.description: The native unit of `applied_value` and `range`; null exactly when `applied_value` is null.

live.description:
Whether `positions` came from a reading taken for THIS call, rather
than from the last one the command path happened to take.

A read on these hands is not free — it competes with the command path
for the arm's single passthrough channel — so a busy hand answers
with its last sample and says so here.

positions.description: Per-axis measured position as a fraction of the axis's range.

positions_wire.description: Per-axis measured position in the raw vendor unit.

side.description: Which arm side it is mounted on.
